ng_visitor_guide.text: Fáilte. Newgrange is about 5,200 years old, built around 3200 BC. That makes it older than Stonehenge and the pyramids at Giza.
Brú na Bóinne means roughly 'the mansion of the Boyne'. It is a World Heritage Site, with Knowth and Dowth nearby.
Our replica passage is the real thing, only with a shorter queue.

ng_visitor_archaeologist.text: Knowth has the biggest collection of passage tomb art in Western Europe. We are still counting, and we are still amazed.
